disclaimer: These are the public sources this run could read. This is not every open United States bid, and it is not BidNet or RFPMart coverage.

sources.name: SAM.gov
sources.reason: Public extract had 16323 open U.S. notices. Published 10000, balanced across states, so the site stays within GitHub Pages size.

sources.name: RFPMart
sources.reason: Public category RSS. Non-U.S. and expired rows are dropped. State and country feeds are not refetched because they repeat the category feeds.

sources.name: Delaware Bids
sources.reason: Weekly open-data extract. Confirm the live notice on the state site.

sources.name: Montgomery County MD
sources.reason: County open-data file. The record links to the dataset because the extract has no per-notice URL.

sources.name: Baton Rouge Bids
sources.reason: Upcoming bid openings from the city open-data file. Past openings are omitted.

sources.name: TxDOT Lettings
sources.reason: Highway lettings aggregated from the public bid-item extract. One row per project. The Texas ESBD portal is a separate source and is not scraped when robots.txt disallows it.

sources.name: NY open data
sources.reason: No open-solicitation file. Catalog hits are surplus sales, capital projects, and authority procurement reports. NYSCR is not open data. data.ny.gov was checked and not copied.

sources.name: TX open data
sources.reason: No statewide solicitation file. The ESBD portal is not an open feed. TxDOT lettings stay in the separate TxDOT source. data.texas.gov was checked and not copied.

sources.name: WA open data
sources.reason: No open-bid dataset. The portal search returns a vendor list, not current solicitations. WEBS is not an open feed. data.wa.gov was checked and not copied.

sources.name: OR open data
sources.reason: No open-bid dataset. OregonBuys is not an open feed. data.oregon.gov was checked and not copied.

sources.name: CO open data
sources.reason: No open-bid dataset. Catalog hits for solicitation are charity filings, not procurement. data.colorado.gov was checked and not copied.

sources.name: IL open data
sources.reason: No open-bid dataset. Future Solicitations are anticipated projects without deadlines, and BidBuy needs a login. data.illinois.gov was checked and not copied.

sources.name: MO open data
sources.reason: No open-bid dataset. MissouriBUYS is not an open feed. data.mo.gov was checked and not copied.

sources.name: PA open data
sources.reason: No open-bid dataset. eMarketplace is not an open feed. data.pa.gov was checked and not copied.

sources.name: NJ open data
sources.reason: No open-bid dataset. NJSTART is not an open feed. data.nj.gov was checked and not copied.

sources.name: CT open data
sources.reason: data.ct.gov catalog has no current solicitation dataset in the first results. Awards and spending files were ignored.

sources.name: MI open data
sources.reason: data.michigan.gov catalog has no current solicitation dataset in the first results. Awards and spending files were ignored.

sources.name: MD open data
sources.reason: opendata.maryland.gov catalog has no current solicitation dataset in the first results. Awards and spending files were ignored.

sources.name: CA open data
sources.reason: data.ca.gov CKAN search did not return a solicitation dataset in the first results.

sources.name: Grants.gov
sources.reason: Grants.gov lists grants, not contract bids. It is not collected.

sources.name: USAspending
sources.reason: USAspending lists awards and spending, not open solicitations. It is not collected.

sources.name: Federal Register
sources.reason: Queried the public Federal Register API for NOTICE documents matching “invitation for bids”. None of the newest 100 titles were themselves a solicitation. FedBizOpps-style contract notices are already in the SAM.gov extract and were not copied twice.

sources.name: GSA eBuy
sources.reason: GSA eBuy requires a login. It was not read. GSA contract notices that are public are already in the SAM.gov extract.

sources.name: Local bid pages
sources.reason: Rows from county and city pages whose robots.txt allowed a simple HTML table, RSS feed, or calendar. Hosted marketplaces are not copied.

sources.name: Bonfire / Euna
sources.reason: Bonfire / Euna: robots.txt disallows the public page we would have read. Listings were not copied.

sources.name: BidNet Direct
sources.reason: BidNet Direct robots.txt allows a generic crawler on the open-solicitations path, disallows paged search URLs, sets a crawl delay, and blocks a list of automated-bot user agents. The terms page is a client-rendered app, so we could not read a license that allows copying those listings into another product. Skipped.

sources.name: DemandStar
sources.reason: DemandStar robots.txt does not disallow the homepage. The terms of use were not available as a stable public document that grants the right to copy solicitations, so no listings were copied.

sources.name: PlanetBids
sources.reason: PlanetBids: robots.txt HTTP 405 PlanetBids does not publish one nationwide open-bid feed we can read without a login. Agency sites on this platform are recorded one by one when a jurisdiction URL is known. No listings were copied from the vendor homepage.

sources.name: OpenGov Procurement
sources.reason: OpenGov Procurement: robots.txt was not a robots file (HTML challenge or app shell) Listings were not copied.
